mechanics.claim: Vault Breaker is a channel that must be recast to deal damage; damage scales with charge time up to 1.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 150 for 11|0 to 1.25|round1=3|formula=15% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}

mechanics.claim: If the charge completes without recast, the ability is cancelled, half the mana is refunded, and it goes on full cooldown.
mechanics.quote: If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Vault Breaker'' is cancelled, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded, and it is placed on {{sti|cd|full cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: If interrupted while charging, half the mana is refunded and it goes on a short 3-second cooldown instead of full cooldown.
mechanics.quote: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded and it is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the dash/recast effect resolves, not on initial cast.
Vi stops upon hitting an enemy champion and knocks them back, so only the first champion hit is struck by the dash (others in path are non-champions pulled toward her).
mechanics.quote: She stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} over {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Vi is slowed by 15% while channeling, but this does not affect damage output in a stationary fight.
Stuck targets are briefly immune to being hit again by Vault Breaker from the same caster.
mechanics.quote: Stuck targets (including those that block ''Vault Breaker'' with a {{tip|spell shield}}) are briefly immune to being affected again by ''Vault Breaker'' from this player, for about {{fd|1.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Relentless Force and Cease and Desist can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Relentless Force|Vi}} and {{ai|Cease and Desist|Vi}} can be cast during the dash.''
